original_question:
Design a Verilog module named `dff_rs`.
The module should have the following inputs: `clk`, `rst`, `set`, and `d`.
The module should have a single output: `q`.
Implement a D-type flip-flop with synchronous reset and synchronous set.
The output `q` should update on the positive edge of the `clk` signal.
The `rst` input should provide a synchronous reset function, forcing `q` to 0 when high. This reset should have the highest priority.
If `rst` is not high, the `set` input should provide a synchronous set function, forcing `q` to 1 when high. This set should have lower priority than reset.
If neither `rst` nor `set` is high, the output `q` should capture the value of the input `d` on the clock edge.
